stories.title: B.C. woman dies outside emergency room that closes daily at 5pm
stories.summary: A B.C. woman's family has been left shattered and grieving after she died outside of the closed emergency department at Port Hardy Hospital last week.

stories.title: B.C. trial in author Stephen Galloway’s defamation lawsuit enters final week
stories.summary: Final submissions in the trial of author and former UBC professor Stephen Galloway's defamation lawsuit are set to begin in B.C. Supreme Court in Vancouver Monday.

stories.title: B.C. Greens take the oath of office as Leader Lowan laments failed climate conference
stories.summary: Green Party Leader Emily Lowan and her caucus colleague Jeremy Valeriote will be sworn into office today at the legislature and Lowan has already set the tone for her tenure.

stories.title: Tumbler Ridge begins consultation on design for new school building
stories.summary: Six people were killed in Tumbler Ridge when 18-year-old Jesse Van Rootselaar opened fire at the northeastern B.C. school on Feb. 10.

stories.title: Elks continue Grey Cup celebration with parade
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks capped off a week of celebrating their Grey Cup win by leading a holiday parade on Saturday.

stories.title: Kelowna city hall faces more transparency questions after wage hike kept quiet
stories.summary: While the former council was kept apprised of the negotiations, residents were not given a public announcement before the vote.

stories.title: WATCH: Global Okanagan News at 5:30 p.m. – Nov. 20
stories.summary: Watch the online news edition of Global Okanagan at 5:30 p.m.

stories.title: Indian national gets more than 19 years in prison over plot to kill Sikh leader
stories.summary: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty earlier this year to charges related to a murder-for-hire scheme for attempting to kill Gurpatwant Singh Pannun.

stories.title: Man accused of Bailey McCourt’s murder granted psychiatric assessment
stories.summary: Plover's defence lawyer was granted an application request Wednesday for an in-custody psychiatric assessment to examine his mental state at the time of the offence.

stories.title: Lorne Doerkson becomes B.C.’s 38th premier, announces cabinet positions
stories.summary: British Columbia's first Conservative government in almost a century will take the reins of power when Lorne Doerkson becomes premier and unveils his first cabinet.
